baselineChoice: Self-relative descriptive model against archive-covered format baseline averages (ODI: 58.34 across 311 archive matches; T20I: 48.33 across 118 matches). Cross-player calibration blocked due to single-player scope.
blockerReason: Tournament finals sample sizes (N=10 ODI, N=3 T20I; T20I knockouts N=7) fall below the robust threshold, bootstrap uncertainty width exceeds 25.0 runs/dismissal, and cross-player peer corpus is unavailable in a single-player dataset. Public score must remain null.

legacyModel.description: Editorial hypothesis model comparing raw split averages to overall format career averages with linear 70-anchor scaling.
legacyModel.formula: ratio = splitAvg / baseAvg; score = min(100, max(0, round(ratio * 70)))
knownWeaknesses: Circular scoring / collinearity: Tournament finals are a strict subset of knockouts, which frequently overlap with run chases (double counting).
Small sample volatility: Tournament finals (N=7 ODI, N=2 T20I) exhibit excessive variance where single boundary events alter the score by >15 points.
Self-relative bias: Comparing a player only against their own career baseline cannot produce an absolute universal score across players.
Arbitrary 70-point anchor: Scaling ratio 1.0 to 70 points was an editorial heuristic rather than empirically calibrated against peer distributions.
Missing zero-dismissal safeguards and uncertainty intervals.
legacyModel.whyNeverProductionTrusted: Lacked cross-player peer corpus, lacked collinearity corrections, and lacked statistical confidence intervals.

componentsSpec.label: Chasing Innings Dominance
componentsSpec.description: Batting performance in 2nd innings run chasing appearances where a target was pursued regardless of final match outcome.
componentsSpec.inclusionRules: Second innings chases with known target (excluding abandoned without play).
componentsSpec.deliveryRules: All legal deliveries and no-balls faced by the batter while chasing.
componentsSpec.numerator: Runs scored in 2nd innings run chases.
componentsSpec.missingDataBehavior: Returns status: insufficient-sample with score: null.
componentsSpec.normalizationMethod: Tanh bounded transformation vs baseline: 50 + 50 * tanh((splitAvg - baseAvg) / baseAvg).
componentsSpec.interpretationLimitation: High score indicates chase elevation, but does not isolate death-over high RRR situations from comfortable chases.

componentsSpec.label: High-Pressure Situations (RRR >= 8.0)
componentsSpec.description: Batting performance during run chase deliveries where the required run rate is stiff, severe, or extreme (>= 8.0 rpo).
componentsSpec.inclusionRules: Deliveries with finite requiredRunRate >= 8.0 and ballsRemaining > 0.
componentsSpec.deliveryRules: Official batter balls faced (legal deliveries + no-balls, excluding wides).
componentsSpec.denominator: Dismissals when RRR >= 8.0 (if dismissals > 0) and official balls faced for strike rate.
componentsSpec.baseline: Format overall chase strike rate and career average.
componentsSpec.missingDataBehavior: Returns status: insufficient-sample with score: null.
componentsSpec.normalizationMethod: Composite metric combining scoring rate elevation and dismissal resistance.
componentsSpec.interpretationLimitation: Deliveries are situational slices; small-sample cells within specific phases can skew rates.

componentsSpec.label: Tournament Knockout Elevation
componentsSpec.description: Batting performance in ICC and continental tournament knockout fixtures (quarter-finals, semi-finals, finals, Super 8/12 knockout deciders).
componentsSpec.inclusionRules: Matches tagged with tournament stage knockout, semi-final, final, or quarter-final in stage overrides.
componentsSpec.deliveryRules: All deliveries faced in knockout fixtures.
componentsSpec.missingDataBehavior: Returns status: insufficient-sample with score: null.
componentsSpec.normalizationMethod: Ratio vs baseline transformed via bounded sigmoid / tanh curve.
componentsSpec.interpretationLimitation: Knockout matches occur infrequently; sample size in T20I (N=7) remains below minimum threshold.

componentsSpec.label: Tournament Finals Impact
componentsSpec.description: Batting performance strictly in tournament finals (ICC World Cup, Champions Trophy, T20 World Cup, Asia Cup finals).
componentsSpec.inclusionRules: Matches tagged with stage final in verified match stage registry.
componentsSpec.deliveryRules: All deliveries faced in tournament finals.
componentsSpec.missingDataBehavior: Returns status: insufficient-sample with score: null.
componentsSpec.normalizationMethod: Bounded deviation scoring vs format baseline.
componentsSpec.interpretationLimitation: CRITICAL SAMPLE LIMITATION: Limited sample sizes in tournament finals (N=10 ODI, N=3 T20I; T20I knockouts N=7) fail the robust calibration thresholds.
